notes.key_messages:
• A considerable proportion of the total marks depend on giving answers which are correct to 3
significant figures. In order to gain as many marks as possible all working should be either exact or
correct to at least 4 significant figures.
• It is important for candidates to not spend too much time on any one question.
notes.general_comments:
Nearly every candidate was able to attempt all six questions. Answers to Questions 1 and 6 part (ii), both of
which concerned the normal distribution, were usually correct.
